Remark
[General right-hand side and the isomorphism $L_\mu $] ↗ thm:first-existence-weak-solutions ↗ def:weak-solution-elliptic-bvp 1. ch6:6.2-rem-2\group Weak Solutions

For \[ f^i \in L^2(U) \quad (i=0,\ldots ,n), \] there is a unique weak solution $u$ of \[ (9) \qquad \begin{cases} Lu + \mu u = f^0 - \sum _{i=1}^n f^i_{x_i} & \text{in } U \\ u = 0 & \text{on } \partial U. \end{cases} \] because $\langle f,v\rangle = \int _U f^0v + \sum _{i=1}^n f^iv_{x_i}\, dx$ is bounded on $H_0^1(U)$.

In particular, we deduce that the mapping \[ L_\mu = L + \mu I : H_0^1(U) \to H^{-1}(U) \quad (\mu \geq \gamma ) \] is an isomorphism.
